data.action: 怀抱厚厚精装书倚在书架旁，透过书架空隙不经意回眸
data.camera: medium shot, standing beside library shelves and peeking between books
data.description: 【艾莉 · 图书馆午后·书架后的凝视】午后静谧的图书馆深处，艾莉怀抱着厚厚的精装参考书穿梭在书架之间。透过书册的缝隙，她悄悄打量着对面正抓耳挠腮做题的你，唇角泛起一抹藏不住的笑意——「这道数学题有那么难吗？真是个让人放不下心的家伙……」
data.lighting: warm dust motes in sunbeams filtering between bookshelves
data.promptProse: Holding the books against her chest, she peeks through a shelf gap toward the viewer studying beyond it, a small smile at her lips. The viewer remains outside the frame as afternoon sunlight catches her hair and the book edges.
data.title: 艾莉莎·米哈伊洛夫娜·九条 · 图书馆午后·书架后的凝视
